name: Not for the Timid
description: The Federation is young in comparison to many of the factions it has encountered. Q thinks that sending the Federation 'back to basics' may not be such a terrible idea. For there are dangers lurking in the stars its members could hardly imagine.
rules:
-- Unique Federation, Klingon, and Romulan Faction Missions are available during the event. Open the Event to access them.
-- Using Phillip Green, any version of Spock, Kyle, Sulu, ENT crew, or TOS crew will provide a bonus to Event Faction Missions.
-- Every Event Faction Mission you succeed at earns you Event Victory Points. Collect Victory Points to unlock Event Threshold Rewards.
-- In this event, Squadrons may also compete to advance up the Squadron leaderboards. Join a Squadron to get more rewards!
bonus_text: Crew Bonus: Phillip Green, Spock, Kyle, Sulu, ENT, TOS
rewards_teaser: Reach Rank 1 by gaining Victory Points from Event Missions!
